description.message: Fill forms with your private details and write their answers, without the AI ever seeing those details.

pairHint.message: Or in Igrek, open Settings, Browser extension, make a pairing key and paste it here.

notPaired.message: This key is not paired with Igrek any more. Make a new one in Igrek's Settings.

noPage.message: Open the page with the form first.

fillHint.message: Finds the fields that ask for one of your private details (T.C. kimlik, IBAN, student number...) and fills them here in the browser.

found.message: $1 fields match your private details. Untick what should stay empty.

nothingFound.message: No field here asks for one of your private details.

writeHint.message: Click into the field on the page first (for example "Why do you want this scholarship?"), then say what to write.

writePlaceholder.message: For example: a short, sincere answer about my studies

usesLimit.message: Asks an AI model, so it uses your plan's limit. The AI sees placeholders, never your private details.

clickField.message: Click into the field on the page first, then try again.

written.message: Written into the field. Read it before you send the form.

rules.message: Your details go from Igrek on this computer straight into the page. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

actHint.message: Ask about the page, or say what to do. Igrek proposes steps; each is shown on the page and done only when you click it.

actPlaceholder.message: For example: what does this plan include? Or: fill the delivery address with my details

picking.message: Click the element on the page (Esc to stop).

riskyConfirm.message: This step sends, pays, deletes or publishes something: $1. Do it?

stepGone.message: That element is not on the page any more. Ask again for new steps.

needClick.message: To work on this page, click Igrek's toolbar icon once more (the browser allows it page by page).

pairCode.message: Igrek shows the code $1. Allow it there if it is the same.

pairDenied.message: Igrek did not allow it. Press Connect to ask again.
